title: Synthetic corporate card policy
applicability: Synthetic Synthetic corporate card policy product only; monetary amounts are integer minor units.
content:
This local corporate-card simulator is separate from any existing card product. xp_c_cards and xp_c_card_purchases expose cycle usage, categories and merchants. A deny wins over every exception. Merchant exception overrides the category transaction cap; category cap overrides the default. The cycle cap independently bounds total posted spend. configure_card_policy changes these controls; execute_card_purchase debits the account and consumes cycle capacity. Freezing is immediate. Removing a prohibited-category deny may expose later purchases even if no prohibited purchase has occurred. Negative-category probes can be computed from the resulting policy. Source motif only: 03_medium_30_to_50pct/world-card-limit-setting.sop.md — The source describes single, daily and monthly card limits. All policy precedence and synthetic control operations here are newly defined.

Synthetic linked-ledger extension v4. Query xp_c_card_authorizations. manage_card_authorization accepts record_id, action, reference, amount_minor. Obtain bank status for authorization holds. A void order can be cancelled; cancelling a delivered order waives its reservation without cancelling its debt. Employee scope and a required-purchase reservation jointly consume available cycle permission. retrieve_authorizations publishes the reference and amount of the void-order and delivered-order holds. Both occupy the cycle before cancellation, in addition to posted spent_minor. cancel_authorization uses the selected order reference; it releases that hold but does not erase an already delivered order debt. assign_employee uses one of employees as reference and binds the listed merchant scope. reserve_purchase_amount uses the target purchase reference and its amount. At purchase, posted spend plus surviving other holds plus the new amount must fit cycle_cap_minor; the purchase reservation is not counted twice. A ready outcome is valid if the same real remaining capacity, cash, employee and merchant scope would permit purchase; no current purchase is mandatory. Permitted actions: retrieve_authorizations, cancel_authorization, assign_employee, reserve_purchase_amount. Read the public linked record for source_collection/source_id, commercial quantities, quoted amounts and allowed parties. Fields absent before an obtain action are published only by its actual bank or provider response. Obtain actions are service requests and require approval. Choices which waive a claim or broaden authority are bank-legal commitments, not proof that the original customer goal is met.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `configure_card_policy`

Configure the synthetic corporate card. merchant_exception sets one merchant's per-transaction cap; category_limit sets one category cap; global_limit sets the cycle cap; block_category adds a deny; allow_category removes a deny; freeze disables spending. Denies override exceptions; transaction caps and remaining cycle cap both apply.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `card_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `mode` | string: `merchant_exception`, `category_limit`, `global_limit`, `block_category`, `allow_category`, `freeze` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `selector` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | amount minor (integer minor currency units). |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `execute_card_purchase`

Attempt one synthetic corporate-card purchase. It debits cash and occupies cycle capacity only when the active card, category deny, transaction cap and cycle cap all permit it.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `purchase_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `manage_card_authorization`

Obtain bank status for authorization holds. A void order can be cancelled; cancelling a delivered order waives its reservation without cancelling its debt. Employee scope and a required-purchase reservation jointly consume available cycle permission. Actions: retrieve_authorizations, cancel_authorization, assign_employee, reserve_purchase_amount. reference identifies the public business reference or named party; amount_minor records the explicit amount involved. Read the product article for local dependencies.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `retrieve_authorizations`, `cancel_authorization`, `assign_employee`, `reserve_purchase_amount` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `reference` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | amount minor (integer minor currency units). |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
